promptText: For an upper-upscale hotel project in the Caribbean and Latin America, which brands are commonly shortlisted by owners and developers?

payload.rawResponseText:
For an **upper-upscale hotel in the Caribbean or Latin America**, owners typically begin with the following brand universe. Exact classification varies by chain—some call the segment “premium,” “upper-upscale,” or “lifestyle.”

### Core international shortlist

| Brand family | Brands commonly considered | Typical fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Marriott International** | **Westin, Renaissance, Marriott Hotels, Le Méridien, Autograph Collection**; sometimes Tribute Portfolio | Resorts, major urban hotels, convention properties and independent/lifestyle concepts. Autograph is particularly common where the owner wants design flexibility and local identity. ([hotel-development.marriott.com](https://www.hotel-development.marriott.com/brands/premium-brands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hilton** | **Hilton Hotels & Resorts, Curio Collection, Canopy by Hilton**; occasionally DoubleTree or Tapestry Collection at the lower end | Hilton for conventional full service; Curio for independent resorts and conversions; Canopy for lifestyle-oriented urban projects. Hilton reported more than 300 operating hotels and over 150 pipeline projects in CALA at the end of 2025. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-ends-2025-with-robust-luxury-and-lifestyle-growth-across-the-caribbean-and-latin-america?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Hyatt** | **Hyatt Regency, The Unbound Collection, JdV by Hyatt**; Grand Hyatt or Andaz where the project can support a higher positioning | Hyatt Regency for larger resorts/MICE hotels; Unbound and JdV for locally distinctive properties. Hyatt explicitly positions Hyatt Regency as upper-upscale and Unbound across upper-upscale and luxury. ([hyatt.com](https://www.hyatt.com/development/ourbrands?utm_source=openai)) |
| **IHG** | **Hotel Indigo, voco, Crowne Plaza**; Kimpton or Vignette Collection at the upper edge | Hotel Indigo for neighborhood-driven lifestyle; voco for flexible conversions; Crowne Plaza for corporate and meetings demand. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/voco-hotels?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Accor** | **Pullman, Swissôtel, Mövenpick, MGallery Collection** | Pullman for urban/MICE and larger resorts; MGallery for independent, design-led hotels; Swissôtel and Mövenpick where international or European-source demand is important. Accor identifies MGallery as upper-upscale and Pullman, Swissôtel and Mövenpick as its principal premium brands. ([group.accor.com](https://group.accor.com/en/news-stories/500-premium-hotels-milestone-camil-yazbeck-benoit-racle?utm_source=openai)) |
| **Wyndham** | **Wyndham Grand, Registry Collection Hotels** | Wyndham Grand for conventional upper-upscale resorts; Registry for soft-brand affiliations and owner flexibility. Wyndham classifies both in upper-upscale, with Registry as a soft brand. ([development.wyndhamhotels.com](https://development.wyndhamhotels.com/upscale-lifestyle-hotel-brands/?utm_source=openai)) |

### If the project is all-inclusive

The shortlist usually changes materially. Common candidates include:

- **Hyatt Inclusive Collection:** Dreams, Secrets, Hyatt Ziva, Hyatt Zilara, Breathless and Zoëtry. Hyatt’s Inclusive Collection has more than 150 resorts, concentrated heavily in Latin America, the Caribbean and Europe. ([newsroom.hyatt.com](https://newsroom.hyatt.com/2026-january-27-hyattinclusivecollectionleadershipappointment?utm_source=openai))
- **Marriott:** Autograph Collection All-Inclusive, including Royalton-affiliated properties; selected Marriott, Westin and other full-service brands may also be considered. ([help.marriott.com](https://help.marriott.com/s/article/marriott-all-inclusive-hotels?utm_source=openai))
- **Hilton:** Curio Collection and Hilton Hotels & Resorts, particularly for upscale all-inclusive resort conversions or distinctive new builds. ([stories.hilton.com](https://stories.hilton.com/releases/hilton-ends-2025-with-robust-luxury-and-lifestyle-growth-across-the-caribbean-and-latin-america?utm_source=openai))
- **IHG/Iberostar:** Iberostar Selection and, at the higher end, JOIA by Iberostar. ([development.ihg.com](https://development.ihg.com/hotel-brands/iberostar?utm_source=openai))
- **Meliá Hotels International:** Meliá Hotels & Resorts and **Paradisus by Meliá** where the project is closer to luxury all-inclusive. ([onboarding.melia.com](https://onboarding.melia.com/landings/home_english.html?utm_source=openai))
- **Palladium/Wyndham:** Grand Palladium and TRS/Registry Collection, especially in Mexico and the Caribbean. ([corporate.wyndhamhotels.com](https://corporate.wyndhamhotels.com/news-releases/wyndham-crosses-100-hotel-mark-in-mexico/?utm_source=openai))
- **Barceló Hotel Group:** Barceló Hotels & Resorts and relevant premium resort concepts, especially for larger destination resorts. ([barcelogrupo.com](https://www.barcelogrupo.com/en/barcelo-hotel-grupo/brand-intro/?utm_source=openai))

### Practical shortlists by project type

**Conventional beachfront resort**
- Westin
- Renaissance
- Hilton
- Hyatt Regency
- Pullman
- Wyndham Grand

**Independent or lifestyle resort**
- Autograph Collection
- Curio Collection
- The Unbound Collection
- Hotel Indigo
- MGallery
- Registry Collection

**Urban corporate/MICE hotel**
- Marriott Hotels
- Westin
- Renaissance
- Hilton
- Hyatt Regency
- Crowne Plaza
- Pullman

**All-inclusive resort**
- Dreams or Secrets
- Hyatt Ziva or Zilara
- Autograph Collection All-Inclusive
- Curio Collection
- Iberostar Selection
- Meliá or Paradisus
- Grand Palladium/TRS

In practice, the final shortlist is usually narrowed according to **destination exclusivity, room count, all-inclusive versus European Plan, source markets, airlift, residential component, conversion versus new build, required key money, fee load and brand-standard construction cost**. A credible first-round owner RFP normally contains roughly **five to eight brands**, rather than every brand listed above.
